assumptions: The field repo's junk was generated exclusively by the archiver code paths present in git history (no forked/patched variants in the wild)
constraints: No commits, no version bumps, no CHANGELOG edits (controller merges)
archive/ is backend-agnostic plain files — pass must work under both file and sqlite backends
context: Fixed #35: added opt-in compact_archives pass to twining_housekeeping — streaming repair for archive/*.jsonl junk from the pre-1.24.0 auto-archive loop. Preview reports counts/bytes; execute compacts atomically, deletes emptied files, posts audit finding.
rationale: History shows only one naming scheme ever existed ({YYYY-MM-DD}-blackboard.jsonl), but the junk signature — not the filename — gates what is dropped, so filename-agnostic scanning is free robustness for foreign layouts.
summary: Compaction scans every *.jsonl under .twining/archive/ regardless of filename
